text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear thesis and organized paragraphs with transitions like 'Firstly,' 'Secondly,' 'Thirdly,' and 'In conclusion,'","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how well ideas are sequenced and connected into a coherent essay structure."},{"evidence":"Extended explanation of 'confidence,' 'challenge,' and 'pride' with repeated links back to the claim","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully the writer elaborates and supports the main argument."},{"evidence":"Varied sentence openings and mostly controlled complex sentences","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures more consistent management of sentence structure and subordination."},{"evidence":"More accurate word choice in phrases like 'setting high goals requires confidence' and 'benefits me more'","quality":"word choice","description":"This captures more precise and effective vocabulary use for the intended meaning."},{"evidence":"Fewer distracting grammar issues overall despite some errors like 'abilties' and 'emitts'","quality":"grammatical control","description":"This captures stronger control of standard English grammar and agreement across the essay."},{"evidence":"Concrete examples such as varsity tennis, honors courses, and a poetry competition","quality":"supporting detail","description":"This captures the use of specific, relevant examples to make the argument more convincing."}]}
